release_metadata.purpose: Matched CPU-only / accelerated measurements, executed by the user in Jupyter

local_validation.scope: Local validation only; board paired results pending

metric_notes.algorithm_seconds: raw rdcycle interval / hardware clock; API only
metric_notes.run_wait_seconds: CPU start to observed completion; includes boot, firmware work and polling
metric_notes.upload_seconds: clear input/output mailboxes and transfer one fixture
metric_notes.download_seconds: read output, profile and hardware counters
metric_notes.wall_seconds: entire host case, including reset, transport, waiting and verification
metric_notes.baseline: HISTORICAL_RTL_CPU_ONLY; not a live CPU-only board measurement
metric_notes.speedup: Compare matched live cpu_only and accelerated firmware on this same bitstream
metric_notes.firmware_load: Full RAM clear, image transfer and full readback excluded; reported separately
